metadata.phase: Phase 4D — Formal Statistical Hypothesis Testing & Effect-Size Analysis
metadata.scope_of_inference_statement: All pooled statistical inferences (N = 824) apply strictly to the 824 paired test utterances and 2 held-out test speakers (p232: 393 utterances; p257: 431 utterances) of the official Edinburgh VoiceBank-DEMAND benchmark. Because resampling utterances within only 2 fixed speaker clusters cannot estimate between-speaker variance across a general human population, broad generalization to unseen speaker populations is not claimed.

symmetry_and_normality.symmetry_assessment: Approximate symmetry satisfied (|g1| <= 0.50, |Bowley| <= 0.15, |HL - Median|/IQR <= 10%); Wilcoxon Signed-Rank is well-suited as a location-shift test alongside the symmetry-free Sign Test.

primary_paired_sign_test.role: Primary symmetry-free test of median difference (H0: Median(d) = 0)

complementary_wilcoxon_signed_rank.role: Complementary location-shift test of pseudo-median (H0: theta_HL = 0)

symmetry_and_normality.symmetry_assessment: Pronounced skewness/asymmetry detected (ceiling compression / tail skew); Paired Sign Test MUST be prioritized for median inference, while Wilcoxon Signed-Rank reflects pseudo-median shift.

operational_threshold_analysis.methodological_note: Because neither ITU-T Rec. P.862.2 nor Taal et al. (2011) mandates a single universal per-utterance JND/MCID constant, categorical cutoffs are explicitly labeled as Exploratory Operational Thresholds informed by subjective MOS residual uncertainty (~0.10-0.25 MOS-LQO in ITU-T P.862.2 / Hu & Loizou 2008) and logistic intelligibility saturation (Taal et al. 2011). A full multi-threshold sensitivity analysis is included.
